SELECT documents_1.id AS documents_1_id, extracted_fields.id AS extracted_fields_id, extracted_fields.document_id AS extracted_fields_document_id, extracted_fields.label AS extracted_fields_label, extracted_fields.is_predefined AS extracted_fields_is_predefined, extracted_fields.value AS extracted_fields_value, extracted_fields.confidence AS extracted_fields_confidence, extracted_fields.status AS extracted_fields_status, extracted_fields.error AS extracted_fields_error, extracted_fields.attempts AS extracted_fields_attempts, extracted_fields.page AS extracted_fields_page, extracted_fields.original_value AS extracted_fields_original_value, extracted_fields.edited_at AS extracted_fields_edited_at, extracted_fields.text_value AS extracted_fields_text_value, extracted_fields.number_value AS extracted_fields_number_value, extracted_fields.currency AS extracted_fields_currency, extracted_fields.date_from AS extracted_fields_date_from, extracted_fields.date_to AS extracted_fields_date_to, extracted_fields.table_index AS extracted_fields_table_index, extracted_fields.row_index AS extracted_fields_row_index, extracted_fields.embedding AS extracted_fields_embedding 
FROM documents AS documents_1 JOIN extracted_fields ON documents_1.id = extracted_fields.document_id AND extracted_fields.is_predefined IS false 
WHERE documents_1.id IN (%(primary_keys_1)s::UUID) ORDER BY extracted_fields.page, extracted_fields.table_index, extracted_fields.row_index, extracted_fields.id

SELECT extracted_fields.id, extracted_fields.document_id, extracted_fields.label, extracted_fields.is_predefined, extracted_fields.value, extracted_fields.confidence, extracted_fields.status, extracted_fields.error, extracted_fields.attempts, extracted_fields.page, extracted_fields.original_value, extracted_fields.edited_at, extracted_fields.text_value, extracted_fields.number_value, extracted_fields.currency, extracted_fields.date_from, extracted_fields.date_to, extracted_fields.table_index, extracted_fields.row_index, extracted_fields.embedding, documents.filename, ts_rank(to_tsvector('spanish'::regconfig, concat_ws(%(concat_ws_1)s::VARCHAR, extracted_fields.label, CAST(extracted_fields.value AS TEXT))), to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, replace(CAST(websearch_to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, %(websearch_to_tsquery_1)s::VARCHAR) AS TEXT), %(replace_1)s::VARCHAR, %(replace_2)s::VARCHAR))) AS score 
FROM extracted_fields JOIN documents ON documents.id = extracted_fields.document_id 
WHERE extracted_fields.is_predefined IS false AND extracted_fields.embedding IS NOT NULL AND documents.document_type IS DISTINCT FROM %(document_type_1)s::VARCHAR AND extracted_fields.document_id IN (%(document_id_1_1)s::UUID) AND (to_tsvector('spanish'::regconfig, concat_ws(%(concat_ws_1)s::VARCHAR, extracted_fields.label, CAST(extracted_fields.value AS TEXT))) @@ to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, replace(CAST(websearch_to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, %(websearch_to_tsquery_1)s::VARCHAR) AS TEXT), %(replace_1)s::VARCHAR, %(replace_2)s::VARCHAR))) ORDER BY ts_rank(to_tsvector('spanish'::regconfig, concat_ws(%(concat_ws_1)s::VARCHAR, extracted_fields.label, CAST(extracted_fields.value AS TEXT))), to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, replace(CAST(websearch_to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, %(websearch_to_tsquery_1)s::VARCHAR) AS TEXT), %(replace_1)s::VARCHAR, %(replace_2)s::VARCHAR))) DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT chunks.id, chunks.document_id, chunks.page, chunks.chunk_index, chunks.content, chunks.embedding, chunks.tsv, documents.filename, ts_rank(chunks.tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, %(websearch_to_tsquery_1)s::VARCHAR)) AS score 
FROM chunks JOIN documents ON documents.id = chunks.document_id 
WHERE (chunks.tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, %(websearch_to_tsquery_1)s::VARCHAR)) AND documents.document_type IS DISTINCT FROM %(document_type_1)s::VARCHAR AND chunks.document_id IN (%(document_id_1_1)s::UUID) ORDER BY ts_rank(chunks.tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('spanish'::regconfig, %(websearch_to_tsquery_1)s::VARCHAR)) DESC 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT conversations.id AS conversations_id, conversations.messages AS conversations_messages, conversations.created_at AS conversations_created_at, conversations.updated_at AS conversations_updated_at 
FROM conversations 
WHERE conversations.id = %(pk_1)s::UUID

SELECT documents.id, documents.filename, documents.content_hash, documents.size_bytes, documents.storage_path, documents.status, documents.document_type, documents.page_count, documents.error_code, documents.error_message, documents.created_at, documents.updated_at

WHERE documents.id = %(id_1)s::UUID
